name: ai-pr-description
description: A GitHub Action that uses OpenAI to generate pull request descriptions.

scripts.bundle: npm run format:write && npm run package
scripts.format:write: prettier --write src __tests__ jest.config.js rollup.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json action.yml package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src __tests__ jest.config.js rollup.config.ts tsconfig.json tsconfig.test.json action.yml package.json
